  Line or code reference: lines 94-97 (module-level import of security_pass_skip via importlib)
  Problem: The import of security_pass_skip.py executes at module load time. If security_pass_skip.py is not present alongside permission_prompts.py in the deployment directory, the entire script becomes unusable even for the report and file subcommands that do not depend on duplicate-check or command-class functionality.
  Why it fails at runtime: An ImportError on a missing security_pass_skip.py would crash report and file subcommands, which run in every /implement-plan-claude stage via the stage report step. In practice this file is always co-located in .claude/scripts/, the twin-parity tests in CI verify its presence, and the two scripts are shipped together through the @stable sync, so the blast radius is limited to deployment mistakes that CI would already surface.
